#FPVideo: Netanyahu's Office Dismisses "Fake" Reports of His Assassination As War With Iran Intensifies 

The Israeli Prime Minister’s Office has debunked viral social media rumours claiming that Benjamin Netanyahu has been assassinated. Netanyahu's office labelled the reports "fake news," confirming that the Israeli PM is fine.  The speculation gained traction during the third week of a high-intensity conflict between Israel and Iran, fuelled by "AI manipulation" allegations regarding a video posted on Netanyahu’s X account and the unusual social media absence of his son, Yair. The rumours surfaced against a backdrop of regional instability following the death of Iran’s former Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. As joint US-Israeli strikes target Iranian military and oil infrastructure, Tehran has ramped up retaliatory strikes across the Gulf. The Iranian Guards have also vowed to "pursue and kill Netanyahu if he is alive." | Firstpost | Facebook
